answer: Pay rewards on delayed vesting. Each epoch's earnings release in equal slices over 30 epochs, and if any audit signal later proves an account sybil, every unvested token is burned. At steady state an account holds about 15 epochs of pay unvested, so a 1,000-puppet farm earning 2 tokens per puppet per epoch keeps about 30,000 tokens at risk. A farm can forge names in minutes but can't skip the wait. Honest agents just wait while pay ripens on the vine.
